passages.text: Our exchange group includes pupils who come from several different towns. At first, we know little about one another beyond the names on our badges. We try to get along with one another by sharing small tasks and listening when someone has a different idea. For our first project, two pupils plan a poster while the others gather information for it. When the plans do not fit together, we discuss the problem instead of blaming a new partner. By the final meeting, the badges are less important because we recognise each other’s interests and strengths.

parallelText.en: Our exchange group includes pupils who come from several different towns.
parallelText.zh: 我们的交流小组包括来自几个不同城镇的学生。

parallelText.en: At first, we know little about one another beyond the names on our badges.
parallelText.zh: 起初，除了胸牌上的名字，我们对彼此了解很少。

parallelText.en: We try to get along with one another by sharing small tasks and listening when someone has a different idea.
parallelText.zh: 我们通过分担小任务、倾听不同想法，努力与彼此相处。

parallelText.en: For our first project, two pupils plan a poster while the others gather information for it.
parallelText.zh: 第一个项目中，两人设计海报，其他人搜集所需信息。

parallelText.en: When the plans do not fit together, we discuss the problem instead of blaming a new partner.
parallelText.zh: 计划不协调时，我们讨论问题，而不责怪新搭档。

parallelText.en: By the final meeting, the badges are less important because we recognise each other’s interests and strengths.
parallelText.zh: 最后一次见面时，胸牌没那么重要了，因为我们已了解彼此的兴趣和长处。

passages.text: At the museum, Kai cannot find the room where his class is meeting. He stays beside the information desk instead of wandering through more galleries. “Excuse me, could you help me find my teacher?” he asks a member of staff. She checks the school’s booking and says, “Don’t worry; your group is in the next room.” She contacts the teacher before taking Kai to the meeting point. Kai thanks her and checks the room number carefully before rejoining his classmates.

parallelText.en: At the museum, Kai cannot find the room where his class is meeting.
parallelText.zh: 在博物馆里，凯找不到班级集合的房间。

parallelText.en: He stays beside the information desk instead of wandering through more galleries.
parallelText.zh: 他留在服务台旁，没有继续在更多展厅里乱走。

parallelText.en: “Excuse me, could you help me find my teacher?” he asks a member of staff.
parallelText.zh: 他向工作人员问：“劳驾，您能帮我找到老师吗？”

parallelText.en: She checks the school’s booking and says, “Don’t worry; your group is in the next room.”
parallelText.zh: 她查看学校预订信息，说：“别担心，你们小组就在隔壁房间。”

parallelText.en: She contacts the teacher before taking Kai to the meeting point.
parallelText.zh: 她先联系老师，再带凯去集合点。

parallelText.en: Kai thanks her and checks the room number carefully before rejoining his classmates.
parallelText.zh: 凯感谢她，仔细核对房间号后重新和同学们会合。
